title: Synthetic factory replay

qualification.scope: Known one-minute shift, gaps, bad quality and counter resets; stored-sample replay, not live PLC qualification

limitations: Synthetic only; no vendor, physical device or operator acceptance.
Node identities and cycle standard must be commissioned for each real machine.
